capabilities: collect expiration dates from a designated note
display items grouped by expiration category in a separate view
search for specific items or categories
configure date format, data file location, and category thresholds
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track expiration dates of physical items like groceries stored in a note.
summary: Expiration-date tracker that reads item tables from a note and shows expiry categories, days remaining, and expired-item notices.
